Good Up Specialty Coffee is a specialty coffee shop located in the Songprapa-Don Mueang area. It boasts a warm, two-story design in a simple, mid-century modern style. They offer a selection of high-quality house blend coffee beans in three roasts (light, medium, and dark), along with filter coffee, non-coffee options, and homemade bakery items.

Location: JE Urban (Jw Urban) Project, Songprapa Road, Don Mueang (Closed Tuesdays)
Atmosphere: Mid-century modern decor with a focus on wood tones and curved walls. The quiet atmosphere is ideal for working or relaxing, with background jazz music.
Recommended Menu Items:
Coffee: House Blend (3 choices), Drip Coffee (Filter), Coffee Tonic with fruit toppings such as yuzu, pineapple, and passion fruit.
Non-Coffee/Bakery: Rich Matcha, Matcha Brownie (less sweet).
